name: dev-sentry-read-an-issue
why: Reading an issue's latest event while debugging, as the use names.

job.purpose: Read Sentry issues and events for the acme/web project while debugging

statements: allow read on issue in project "web" of organization "acme"
allow read on event in project "web" of organization "acme"

definitions.organization: A Sentry organization, by its slug.
definitions.project: A Sentry project, by its slug.
